messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

To make sure this medicine is safe for you, tell your doctor if you have ever had:
- severe narrowing of a certain valve in your heart (aortic stenosis), or other heart problems;
- coronary artery disease (clogged arteries); or
- liver disease.
It is not known if amlodipine will harm an unborn baby. However, having high blood pressure during pregnancy may cause complications or medical problems in both mother and baby. The benefit of treating hypertension may outweigh any risks to the baby.
Do not breastfeed while taking amlodipine. You can stop breastfeeding or take a different medicine.

Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. B. 'has overdose instruction': In case of an overdose of the subject drug the patient should follow the instruction specified by the object entity.
